description: The pie chart represents the distribution of categories related to a particular aspect of LLMs, divided into five slices. The chart is divided into "Instance" (blue, approximately 25%), "Coverage General" (green, approximately 25%), "Scalable Oversight" (red, approximately 25%), "Complexity" (yellow, approximately 25%), and an unlabeled category (light blue or grey-blue, not fully visible). The chart does not include a legend, but each slice is labeled with its corresponding category name and accompanied by a simple icon. Some slice labels are partially obscured by text boxes containing other labels, and the slices appear to be roughly equal in size, arranged in a clockwise order without any visual emphasis on a particular category.
